purpose: analysis-only deterministic adjustment sensitivity using Overture building source, road-network, and place-confidence support indicators; no target-RMSE claim or upload

prior_candidate.scored_region_projection: Use only the 9,379 official GEOIDs, joined by string GEOID; ignore the 415 template-only rows. Historical C2 predictions are a frozen feature-derived adjustment baseline, not a calibration target.

building_source_support.definition: fraction of assigned Overture building records whose sources metadata includes a Microsoft dataset
building_source_support.missing_when: no assigned Overture buildings or unavailable source-share value

road_route_support.interpretation: bounded route-network length share of the two provided Overture length summaries; a support indicator, not a road-completeness estimate
road_route_support.missing_when: both lengths sum to zero or either length is unavailable

place_confidence_support.definition: fraction of assigned Overture places with valid confidence at least 0.5
place_confidence_support.interpretation: provided Overture confidence attribute; not an independent estimate of place truth, completeness, or service availability
place_confidence_support.missing_when: no valid Overture place confidence values or unavailable share

feature_screen_note: A preliminary source-field coverage check found the upstream-provider share equal to 1.0 for every tract with assigned places; that constant attribute was excluded from the final place support score as non-discriminating. The choice of the provided confidence attribute is based only on feature semantics/variation, not on target or leaderboard feedback.

cross_theme_adjustment.cross_theme_support_formula: clip(0.5 * mean(three support features) + 0.5 * min(three support features), 0, 1)
cross_theme_adjustment.adjustment_direction: nonnegative addition to the frozen prior coverage-gap prediction; weaker minimum support increases the conservative score estimate

measurement_plan.before: Record frozen C2 full-artifact hash and official-scope prediction moments; document the existing mechanistic v2 feature schemas and exact challenge-feature columns before applying the final adjustment.
measurement_plan.after: Report four-region feature coverage/missingness, feature moments, pairwise Pearson and Spearman support correlations, per-region prior/adjusted prediction variance, adjustment quantiles/max, changed-row fractions, exact IDs, bounds, and artifact/manifest hashes.

mechanistic_v2_context.transport: provided Overture named-road length and route-network support features; route support is not an organizer target label
mechanistic_v2_context.building: provided Overture positive-count definedness and source metadata; no reference-derived per-tract feature
mechanistic_v2_context.places: provided Overture confidence attribute; no external facility/establishment counts
mechanistic_v2_context.assembly_status: this screen does not assemble or promote the approval-gated v2 component bundle; the frozen C2 prediction remains the prior candidate
